programme.name: Law, Advocacy and Persuasive Performance Minor

notes.text: The minor in Law, Advocacy and Persuasive Performance is an innovative and interdisciplinary minor that explores the intersection between dramatic arts and the law which emphasizes performance-based skills essential to the law and the legal profession: persuasive speaking, improvisation, audience analysis and storytelling.
notes.source_line: The minor in Law, Advocacy and Persuasive Performance is an innovative and interdisciplinary minor that explores the intersection between dramatic arts and the law which emphasizes performance-based skills essential to the law and the legal profession: persuasive speaking, improvisation, audience analysis and storytelling.

notes.text: The minor totals 16 unit: 8 required law and theatre units, 4 law and 4 dramatic arts elective units.
